channel.title: TidyDesk Studio - Free Spreadsheet Guides
channel.description: Free Spreadsheet Guides from TidyDesk Studio

item.title: Why Is My Utility Bill Higher? How to Tell If You Used More or Just Paid More
item.description: A step-by-step way to compare power, gas and water bills against the same month last year and split a higher bill into extra usage versus a higher price. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Track Payments to Contractors and Freelancers So Year-End Totals Take Minutes
item.description: A simple payments log for small businesses that pay freelancers, subcontractors and vendors, with per-payee yearly totals and a paperwork check. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Track Donations and Thank-You Notes for a Small Nonprofit (Before the Year-End Rush)
item.description: A simple way for small nonprofits, clubs and community groups to log every gift, send thank-yous on time and spot supporters who haven't given yet this year. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Plan a Yearly Budget Month by Month (So the Expensive Months Don't Catch You Out)
item.description: Review last year's totals, give each category its own amount for each of the twelve months, then compare plan to date with actual to date and track savings goals alongside. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Make a 12-Month Cash Flow Forecast for a Small Business (and Spot Tight Months Early)
item.description: List what you expect to come in and go out, add it up month by month from your opening balance, and flag any month that dips below a cushion you choose. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Take Holiday Pre-Orders as a Home Baker Without Overbooking Your Oven
item.description: Set pickup slots with cutoffs and capacity, keep one row per order line, and let a few formulas tell you exactly what to bake for each pickup day. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Keep Track of Business Expenses and Receipts So Year-End Isn't a Scramble
item.description: A simple expense log with a receipt status column, a few formulas and a five-minute weekly habit, so every business cost has its receipt when you close the year. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Find Every Subscription You're Paying For (and Decide Which to Cancel)
item.description: A practical way to dig out every recurring charge, turn weekly, quarterly and yearly bills into one monthly figure, and catch renewals and free trials before they bill you. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Make a Holiday Dinner Cooking Timeline (Working Backwards From Serving Time)
item.description: A step-by-step way to plan a big holiday meal by counting back from the moment you want to eat, so every dish is ready together and the oven never double-books. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Calculate Your Real Profit on Each Item You Resell (After Fees and Shipping)
item.description: A simple way to track each item from purchase to sale so you can see true profit, return on cost, days to sell and how much cash is sitting in unsold stock. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Track Paying Off Several Debts at Once (and Actually See Progress)
item.description: How to list every debt, log each payment, and use a few simple formulas to see what's left, what share is paid and roughly how long to go. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Make a Home Maintenance Schedule You'll Actually Keep (Plus What to Check Before Winter)
item.description: A simple way to list regular house jobs, work out when each is next due, and keep a repair and warranty record alongside it. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Make a Holiday Budget That Still Works in January
item.description: Set a holiday total your monthly budget can carry, split it per person, and track every gift so December doesn't spill into the new year. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Keep a Mileage Log for Business Driving (and Catch Up Before Year-End)
item.description: What to record for each business trip, the formulas that total your distance and claim value, and how to rebuild missing months. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Track Unpaid Invoices as a Freelancer (and Chase Them Before It Gets Awkward)
item.description: A one-row-per-invoice system for seeing who owes you, how late they are and when to send a reminder. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Price Handmade Products So Your Time Actually Gets Paid
item.description: A step-by-step way to turn materials, making time, overhead and selling fees into wholesale and retail prices you can defend. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.

item.title: How to Track Rent Payments for Multiple Tenants (Without Missing a Late One)
item.description: A simple monthly system for logging rent, spotting late payments early and knowing what each property really earns. Free step-by-step guide - works in Excel or Google Sheets.
